hero.label: Licensed Professional Counselor · LPC
hero.title: Clarity & Compassion on Your Path to Wellness
hero.subtext: Therapy is a safe, non-judgmental space where you can explore your thoughts, feelings, and challenges. I work with children, adolescents, and adults to provide personalized counseling that meets you where you are.

sections.label: About Lori
sections.heading: Hi, I'm Lori McWeeney, LPC
sections.subheading: With over a decade of experience providing compassionate mental health counseling, I specialize in helping children, adolescents, families, and adults navigate life's challenges with clarity and confidence.

items.title: Education & Credentials
items.text: Master of Science in Clinical Mental Health Counseling · Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) · Certified in evidence-based therapeutic practices

items.title: My Philosophy
items.text: I believe every person deserves a safe, non-judgmental space to explore their thoughts and emotions. My role is to support you with compassion, respect, and genuine care as you work toward your goals.

items.title: Who I Work With
items.text: Children, adolescents, adults, families, and couples navigating anxiety, depression, behavioral challenges, family conflict, relationship difficulties, and major life transitions.

items.title: Based in Cheshire, CT
items.text: In-person sessions at my office in Cheshire and the surrounding communities. I've been serving the Cheshire area and neighboring towns with dedicated, personalized care since 2012.

sections.label: Services
sections.heading: How I Can Help
sections.subheading: A range of therapeutic services designed to meet your unique needs and support your emotional growth.

items.title: Individual Therapy
items.text: One-on-one counseling for children, adolescents, and adults working through anxiety, depression, behavioral challenges, trauma, and personal growth.

items.title: Family Therapy
items.text: Support for families experiencing conflict, adjustment to change, communication difficulties, and strengthening family bonds in a safe, collaborative environment.

items.title: Couples Therapy
items.text: Work with your partner to improve communication, rebuild trust, resolve conflict, and create a stronger, more connected relationship.

items.title: Adolescent Counseling
items.text: Specialized support for teens navigating school stress, peer relationships, identity questions, anxiety, and the challenges of growing up.

items.title: Behavioral & Emotional Support
items.text: Evidence-based approaches to address behavioral challenges, emotional regulation, stress management, and skill-building for greater resilience.

items.title: Life Transitions & Coping
items.text: Guidance through major life changes—loss, divorce, relocation, major decisions—to help you adjust and move forward with confidence.

sections.label: My Approach
sections.heading: Evidence-Based, Person-Centered Care
sections.subheading: I combine proven therapeutic techniques with warmth and genuine connection to support your unique journey.

items.title: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
items.text: Identify thought patterns and behaviors that may be holding you back, and develop practical strategies to shift toward healthier, more positive responses.

items.title: Family Systems Approach
items.text: Understand dynamics within your family and work together to improve communication, set healthy boundaries, and strengthen relationships.

items.title: Mindfulness & Coping Skills
items.text: Build practical tools for emotional regulation, stress management, and self-care to support your well-being every day.

items.title: Collaborative & Compassionate
items.text: Your voice matters. I listen carefully, honor your perspective, and work with you as a partner in creating meaningful change.

sections.label: Client Stories
sections.heading: Words From Those I've Worked With
sections.subheading: The real impact of therapy is reflected in the experiences and growth of the people I'm honored to serve.
